ViridianCity_House_Text_GirlAsk.en: SPEARY has a hurt wing. Daddy's\nout of POTIONS and the MART is\lfar when you are small.\pIf you find three POTIONS, please\ncome back and tell me!
ViridianCity_House_Text_GirlAsk.fr: SPEARY a une aile blessée. Papa n'a\nplus de POTIONS et la BOUTIQUE est\lloin quand on est petit.\pSi tu trouves trois POTIONS,\nreviens me le dire, s'il te plaît !

ViridianCity_House_Text_GirlGives.en: Thank you! SPEARY chirped!\pDaddy kept this for a special day.\nIt is yours now.
ViridianCity_House_Text_GirlGives.fr: Merci ! SPEARY a pépié !\pPapa gardait ça pour un jour\nspécial. C'est à toi maintenant.

ViridianCity_House_Text_GirlOffer.en: You have POTIONS! Can I have three\nfor SPEARY's wing?
ViridianCity_House_Text_GirlOffer.fr: Tu as des POTIONS ! Puis-je en\navoir trois pour l'aile de SPEARY ?

ViridianCity_House_Text_GirlSad.en: Oh... SPEARY will wait. He is brave.

ViridianCity_House_Text_MyDaddyLovesMons.fr: Mon papa aime aussi les POKéMON.

ViridianCity_House_Text_NicknamingIsFun.en: Coming up with nicknames is fun,\nbut it's not so easy to do.\pClever names are nice, but simple\nnames are easier to remember.
ViridianCity_House_Text_NicknamingIsFun.fr: Trouver des surnoms est amusant,\nmais ce n'est pas si facile.\pLes noms malins sont sympas, mais\nles noms simples sont plus faciles\là retenir.
